operators.name: abs_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise absolute value: y = |x| for each element.
Input is a CUDA float32 tensor of shape [128, 3, 1024, 1024] with strides [3145728, 1048576, 1024, 1].
Output dtype is torch.float32, same shape and strides as input.
Matches torch.abs(x).
No broadcasting, no reduction, order irrelevant.

operators.name: gt_scalar_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise greater-than comparison: y = x > threshold.
Input x is a CUDA float32 tensor of shape [128, 3, 1024, 1024] with strides [3145728, 1048576, 1024, 1].
threshold is a Python float scalar, default 0.5.
Output is torch.bool, same shape and strides as input.
Matches torch.gt(x, torch.tensor(0.5)).
No broadcasting, comparison per element.
Element-wise absolute value of a float32 CUDA tensor.
Output float32, same shape and strides.
No dtype change, no broadcasting.
Element-wise comparison of float32 tensor with scalar 0.5.
Input is the result of step_001 (float32, same shape/strides).
Output bool tensor, same shape and strides.
Comparison operator >, broadcast scalar to tensor.
Return the bool tensor from step_002.
Shape [128, 3, 1024, 1024], dtype torch.bool, device cuda:0, strides [3145728, 1048576, 1024, 1].
